• Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across all business functions.

• Translate business problems into clear analytical and reporting requirements.

• Act as the trusted advisor between business users and technical delivery teams.

**Requirements Gathering**

* Capture, document and validate business requirements.
* Produce high-quality Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications

and user stories where appropriate.

* Ensure acceptance criteria are clearly defined before development begins.

**Data & Analytics Delivery**

* Work alongside Data Engineers, BI Developers and Data Architects

throughout project delivery.

* Validate that delivered dashboards and reports meet agreed business requirements.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Assist with backlog refinement and prioritisation.

**Business Systems Collaboration**

* Work closely with Business Systems Specialists, Product Owners and System Administrators.
* Develop an understanding of operational systems including their processes, workflows and

data structures.

* Identify where required data resides across business applications.
* Understand upstream and downstream system dependencies.
* Support data mapping exercises between source systems and analytics platforms.
* Help resolve data quality or process issues through collaboration with system owners.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Manage stakeholder expectations throughout delivery.
* Escalate risks, issues and dependencies where appropriate.

jobs.title: Business Analyst- Government Projects
jobs.description:
**About Niti Aide**

Niti Aide builds AI and digital solutions for government: dashboards for senior officers, citizen-facing WhatsApp and web assistants, and monitoring platforms for departments and public bodies. We are empanelled with NISG and work with bodies such as HMWSSB, GHMC, and TGMSIDC across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. We’re a small, founder-led team, and the work you bring in is the work we build.

**The role**

This is not a desk BA job. You’ll spend 3–4 days a week inside government offices, meeting officers, understanding how departments actually run, and finding problems worth solving. Then you’ll work with our product and tech team to turn those problems into solutions, and follow through until the work order is signed.

You’ll own a set of departments end to end, from first meeting to signed work order, and you’ll be measured on it.

**What you’ll do**

* Visit government offices regularly and build working relationships with officers and their teams
* Run discovery conversations: how the department works, what data it has, which reviews it faces, and where it struggles
* Turn those conversations into clear one-page problem statements
* Co-design solutions with the founders and tech team
* Present concept notes, proposals and demos to officers
* Track tenders, RFPs, empanelments and nomination opportunities
* Follow up persistently on meetings, file movement and approvals until the work order comes through
* Maintain a clean pipeline of departments, stakeholders and next steps

**Who we’re looking for**

* MBA (2024–26 batch), or 1–3 years in B2B, institutional or field sales, or consulting
* Confident, well-presented and mature in conversation. You should be able to hold your own with senior officers, and we’ll coach you on the rest.
* A structured thinker who can turn a messy one-hour meeting into a crisp problem statement
* Fluent in Telugu, with strong spoken and written English
* Comfortable with Docs, Sheets and slides, and curious about AI. No coding needed.
* Willing to travel within Hyderabad and occasionally to districts and Amaravati. A two-wheeler or car is preferred.

**Strong advantages**

* Internship or work experience with a governance consulting firm, govtech company, PMU, or an industry body (CII, FICCI, NASSCOM)
* Any prior exposure to government departments or tenders

**This role is not for you if**

* You want a 10-to-6 desk job
* You’d rather document problems than chase them to a signed work order
* You’re uncomfortable following up five times to get one meeting

**What you get:**

* A clear path to Senior Business Analyst / Manager within 12–18 months, based on accounts you convert
* Direct work with the founders and real ownership from month one
* A first-hand view of how the state actually runs

This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.

We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.

Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.

Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future

.

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAITM Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data - such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Cogentiq CX
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**About Cogentiq CX**
---------------------

Cogentiq CX is Fractal’s enterprise contact center AI platform, purpose-built for regulated industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Healthcare. It combines voice and chat automation, agent assist, and agentic AI workflows to help enterprises resolve customer interactions faster without compromising compliance, security, or customer trust.

### **The Role**

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and delivery of key capabilities across Cogentiq CX’s voice, chat, and agentic AI stack. You’ll work with engineering, AI/ML, solutions, sales, and customer success to turn customer problems into products that run in production in demanding enterprise contact centers.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for voice and chat automation and agentic AI capabilities
* Translate enterprise customer needs, pilot learnings, and market signals into clear PRDs, user stories, and prioritized backlogs
* Drive design of agentic experiences: orchestration, tool and API integration, guardrails, escalation to human agents, and evaluation frameworks
* Define success metrics (containment, resolution rate, AHT, CSAT, latency, hallucination and compliance rates) and use them to guide iteration
* Partner with engineering and AI teams on architecture trade-offs across ASR/TTS, LLMs, telephony, and CCaaS integrations
* Work with pre-sales, FDEs, and customer success on pilots, POCs, and RFx responses, and carry the learnings back into the product
* Support go-to-market with positioning, demos, sales enablement, and analyst/partner conversations
* Track the competitive landscape (CCaaS vendors, conversational AI platforms, voice AI startups) and sharpen differentiation
* Ensure products meet the security, privacy, and compliance expectations of regulated industries

### **What You Bring**

**Must have**

* 7+ years in product management, with 3+ years on contact center, conversational AI, or CX products
* Hands-on experience shipping voice and/or chat products (IVR modernization, voicebots, chatbots, virtual agents, agent assist)
* Working knowledge of agentic AI: LLM-based agents, tool use, RAG, orchestration, prompt design, and evaluation and guardrails
* Familiarity with the contact center ecosystem: CCaaS platforms (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Avaya, etc.), telephony/SIP, CRM and ticketing integrations
* Experience with enterprise B2B products, including long sales cycles, pilots-to-production, and complex stakeholder environments
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with metrics, experimentation, and data-driven prioritization
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical teams and C-level buyers

**Good to have**

* Prior experience with regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare) and related compliance requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, data residency)
* Background in classical NLP/NLU (intent and entity models, dialog management) and experience through the shift to GenAI
* Experience with real-time voice challenges: latency, barge-in, turn-taking, multilingual and accent handling
* Exposure to observability, QA, and analytics tooling for conversational systems
* Technical background (engineering or data science) or comfort reading API docs and reviewing architecture
* Experience with partner and marketplace integrations

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

---------------

In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships.  
You will lead the team that looks into strategic and operational aspects of vendors business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.  
  
  
  
A day in the life

As a profitable, PE backed scale up (EMK Capital), Bark offers the best of both worlds: the agility and innovation of a fast moving business combined with financial stability and resources for growth. We recently launched our new marketplace model in Australia (Q4 2025) and are preparing for rollout to the UK and US markets in 2026. You'll have genuine ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape our commercial strategy during a pivotal transformation phase with the chance to make your own contribution to our journey.

**About Bark India**

Bark India is the largest operation of Bark outside the UK, with more than 50 staff members. Bark India started operations in December 2022 and currently manages Marketing and Sales functions for India, South Africa and Singapore. In addition, there is also customer support team that provides support to India and Global operations.

**The Role**

You will lead Bark's SME Sales and Customer Success teams, owning how we activate new small-business Sellers and retain our most valuable ones. You manage managers: three team leads report to you, and you coach and develop them to run high-performing teams.

Your team:

* CSM Lead and their Customer Success Managers, who grow and retain our largest SME accounts.
* SME Sales Lead - North America and their sales agents, selling to US Sellers.
* SME Sales Lead - UK & APAC and their sales agents, selling to UK and APAC Sellers. APAC may move to a dedicated lead as the team grows.

Rep training and onboarding sit with a Sales Specialist and their Managers; your focus is developing the leads and the standards they run to.  
  
***Please note that this role involves managing teams across different shifts and requires working UK business hours, either 13:30–22:30 or 14:30–23:30 IST, depending on UK daylight saving time. These working hours are non-negotiable due to the nature of the role. Please ensure you are comfortable with these hours before applying.***

**What you'll own**

You own day-to-day decisions for CSM and SME Sales. Targets and bonus structures are set by the Global Head of Sales.

* Team performance: deliver the combined team target across SME activations, Elite Pro revenue, marketplace subscriptions, CSM portfolio revenue and active Sellers.
* Operational discipline: set and enforce standards for attendance, activity and call quality.
* Leadership development: coach the three leads, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and build their management capability.
* Hiring: run recruitment for your teams, including open sales agent roles.
* Performance management: manage underperformance through to exit where needed.
* Escalations: be the escalation point for leads, reps and Sellers
* Commercial decisions: approve discounts within agreed limits.
* Process: document every team process, fix gaps, and design and launch new processes where needed.
* Data: use Tableau and Salesforce to track performance, diagnose problems and report to senior leadership.
* Partnerships inside Bark: own SME activities in the wider Bark ecosystem. Represent SME in trading meetings and other relevant internal sessions

**What success looks like**

Your first priorities are to understand the team and the product.

Beyond that, success means:

* Every SME Sales market hitting target.
* Attendance at a satisfactory level.
* CSMs performing above target.
* Clear, documented processes in place across all teams.
* One or two new processes designed and launched.

**What you'll bring**

**Essential**

* 3 years experience managing a sales team
* A track record of managing a performing sales team
* Experience in fast, transactional, high-volume sales.
* Experience owning customer retention.
* High data fluency: comfortable pulling and interpreting data yourself.
* Confidence as an escalation point, working directly with reps and customers when needed.
* Excellent spoken and written English.

**Desirable**

* Experience managing managers.
* Experience in a marketplace, SaaS or subscription business.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience.
* A record of designing and documenting sales or CS processes.

jobs.title: CRM Manager
jobs.description:
#### **About Wego**

Wego is a leading online travel marketplace. Founded in Singapore and dual-headquartered in Singapore and Dubai, we serve travelers across the Middle East, Africa, South Asia and Southeast Asia. Millions of travelers use our apps and websites to compare and book flights and hotels from hundreds of airlines, hotels and travel sites.

From our Bangalore office you will work daily with colleagues in Dubai, Singapore and across the region.

#### **The role**

You will own lifecycle marketing for Wego: every push notification, email, in-app message and WhatsApp message a traveler receives from us, from first install to repeat booking. The job is to turn searchers into bookers and one-time bookers into loyal members, at near-zero media cost.

This is a hands-on ownership role, not a campaign-scheduling role. You set the lifecycle strategy, build and tune the automated journeys, run the promotional calendar, and answer for the revenue CRM drives. Your levers are audience, message, timing and frequency, across more than a dozen markets and two primary languages (English and Arabic).

You will sit in the Performance Marketing team, alongside the paid search, app and display channel owners, and work closely with Product, Martech, Data, Brand and Commercial teams.

#### **What you will own**

##### **Lifecycle strategy and journeys**

* Design, build and continuously improve always-on journeys across the traveler lifecycle: onboarding, search abandonment, checkout abandonment, post-booking cross-sell (flight to hotel), price alerts, reactivation of dormant users and win-back.
* Own the lifecycle roadmap: decide which journeys to build, fix or retire, based on incremental bookings and revenue.
* Lead lifecycle communication for Wego's loyalty programme: member onboarding, tier progression and member-only offers.

##### **Campaigns and calendar**

* Run the broadcast calendar across push, email and in-app: Wego promotions, seasonal moments (Ramadan, Eid, national days, summer and winter peaks), tourism board and partner campaigns.
* Launch and scale WhatsApp as a selective, high-value, consent-led channel.
* Brief and review copy and creative in English and Arabic, with localisation by market.

##### **Segmentation and personalisation**

* Build segments from behaviour, booking history, route and destination intent, language, market and loyalty tier.
* Work with Martech and Data to improve the customer data that feeds CRM: event tracking, attributes, the customer data platform and deep links.
* Coordinate with paid retargeting owners so CRM and paid media complement each other instead of paying twice for the same user.

##### **Experimentation and measurement**

* Run a disciplined test programme: holdout groups, A/B and multivariate tests on message, timing, frequency, channel and offer.
* Own CRM reporting: weekly and monthly performance, with triggered and broadcast sends measured separately and results read by market and language.
* Report on what matters commercially: CRM-attributed bookings and revenue, repeat rate, reactivation rate and incrementality, not only opens and clicks.

##### **Channel health and compliance**

* Protect reach: grow push and email opt-in, manage frequency caps, and keep opt-outs, unsubscribes, uninstalls and deliverability within healthy limits.
* Keep every send compliant with consent and privacy rules across our markets, including India's DPDP Act, Saudi PDPL, Singapore PDPA and GDPR, working with InfoSec and Legal.
* Maintain quality control before every send: audience, tokens, deep links, language and rendering.

#### **What success looks like**

**First 30 days:** you know the stack, the data and every live journey. You have audited the journey library and the broadcast calendar, and shared a ranked list of fixes and gaps.

**First 60 days:** you run the weekly calendar and reporting independently. Your first journey improvements and tests are live, each with a holdout and a clear success measure.

**First 90 days:** you have presented a 6 to 12 month lifecycle roadmap with revenue estimates, and the first measured wins are in the numbers.

#### **How we measure the role**

We measure success across five key areas: **Revenue, Retention, Engagement, Channel Health, and Velocity.**

* **Revenue:** CRM-attributed bookings and revenue, share of bookings from automated journeys, incremental lift against holdouts.
* **Retention:** Repeat booking rate, reactivation of dormant users, flight to hotel cross-sell rate.
* **Engagement:** Click-through and conversion rates by send type (triggered vs broadcast), market and language.
* **Channel health:** Opt-in rate, opt-out and unsubscribe rate, deliverability, uninstalls after push.
* **Velocity:** Tests shipped per month, journeys launched or improved, error-free sends.

#### **What you bring**

* 5 to 8 years in CRM, lifecycle or retention marketing at a consumer app or e-commerce business with a large user base; travel, fintech, food delivery, mobility or marketplaces preferred.
* Mandatory: prior hands-on experience managing CRM across all channels, including email, push notifications, in-app messages, on-site and web notifications, SMS and WhatsApp.
* Mandatory: working knowledge of HTML and CSS for email. You can build, edit and troubleshoot responsive email templates yourself, including rendering across email clients and devices.
* Hands-on depth in a marketing automation platform (WebEngage, MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze or similar): you have built multi-step journeys, segments, templates and personalisation yourself, not only briefed them.
* A track record of owning a revenue or retention number through CRM, and the ability to show how you measured it (holdouts, incrementality, cohort analysis).
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable in SQL and a BI tool (Looker or similar), and able to move from a dashboard to a diagnosis to an action.
* Working knowledge of app CRM mechanics: event schemas, deep…

Equinix would like to inform you about ongoing scams involving fraudulent job listings that are being posted on third-party websites. These scams typically involve individuals impersonating Equinix employees and communicating with applicants primarily through email and chat applications such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or social media platforms like LinkedIn. In these scams, applicants may receive a counterfeit offer letter in exchange for personal identification information, which is falsely presented as part of a new-hire screening process. We want to emphasize that these communications and offers are entirely illegitimate and fraudulent. Please note the following key points to help you identify legitimate Equinix communications- All official correspondence from Equinix employees will originate from an “@equinix.com” email address. Our hiring process includes a comprehensive interview procedure, which consists of in-person meetings and phone interviews. Equinix will never request your Social Security or National ID number during the interview process, nor will we ask you to pay any fees or purchase. At Rolls-Royce, we pioneer the power that matters to our customers, to society and to the planet.

We’re the second largest global provider of defence Aero/Naval-engine products and services globally with 16,000 engines in the service of 160 customers in 100 countries. Our engines power aircraft/Naval ships in every major sector, including transport, combat, patrol, trainers, helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicles.

  

**Summary:**

An exciting opportunity has arisen to influence and shape the future of the Rolls-Royce Defence in India. The role will provide the successful candidate with an opportunity to develop valuable expertise in Business Development, Customer Management and Leadership as well as being part of the team shaping future regional growth strategy. The position will be based in Bangalore. The main element of the role will be to manage all aspects of the strategic relationship with customers such as HAL, Indian Air Force, Indian Navy, BSF and other customers as required. * Timely submission of invoices to HAL and tracking their progress.
* Ensuring that all paperwork and Bank Guarantees are delivered on time.
* Management of overdue debt and timely payments.
* Monitoring disputes and interfacing with Rolls-Royce and HAL for timely closure (technical and contractual).
* Monitor and resolve customer enquiries.
* Manage engagements Rolls-Royce and customer teams.
* Managing the operations of the Rolls-Royce office at HAL.
* Internal stakeholder management with teams in UK, US and other locations as required.
* The role will be required to be at Rolls-Royce office at HAL, up to twice a week and on as required basis.
  

**What we are looking for:**

* A focused individual and a collaborator, driven to succeed and rise to challenging goals.
* A programmatic approach to resolving problems focused on business outcomes.
* Diligence and rigor in understanding all aspects of the partnership with HAL.
* Relentless pursuit of solutions to business challenges of all sizes.
* Collaborative approach to working with teams across Defence and HAL to reach acceptable solutions to various opportunities and challenges.

* Initiative-taker with a keen sense of ownership and hunger to improve the HAL relationship in support of the broader Defence strategy.

Pioneer the performance of the future. Join us and you will develop your skills and expertise to the very highest levels, working in an international environment for a company known the world over for brilliance and innovation.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead design for a product area from problem discovery and framing through research, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, launch and post-launch iteration.
* Translate complex user needs and business objectives into clear product strategies, experience principles and scalable design solutions.
* Identify opportunities beyond the immediate brief, challenge assumptions and influence product direction through strong design judgment.
* Balance customer needs, business outcomes, technical constraints and delivery timelines without losing sight of the core user problem.
* Integrate AI tools into your everyday design workflow for research synthesis, ideation, information architecture, UX writing, prototyping, design exploration and iteration.
* Use AI to explore multiple solution directions, accelerate validation and reduce repetitive design work, while maintaining ownership of the final decisions and output quality.
* Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into customer-facing experiences, including intelligent assistance, contextual recommendations, adaptive journeys and personalised interactions.
* Design for the realities of AI-powered products, including uncertainty, explainability, trust, user control, error recovery and appropriate human intervention.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to assess AI capabilities and constraints, translating them into experiences that are genuinely useful rather than adding AI for its own sake.
* Experiment with emerging tools and workflows, sharing learnings and helping the broader design team adopt effective AI-native practices.
* Work on complex experience challenges involving information architecture, customer segmentation, personalisation, onboarding, conversion, engagement and retention.
* Design journeys that account for different customer contexts, intent, behaviours and levels of familiarity with insurance products.
* Build and evolve reusable patterns, interaction models and design systems that improve consistency and scale across product areas.
* Consider the complete customer journey and its dependencies, rather than optimising individual screens or isolated features.
* Lead and synthesise user research, usability studies, behavioural insights and product data to uncover meaningful opportunities.
* Form design hypotheses and work with Data and Product teams to define success metrics and validate solutions.
* Use AI-assisted research and analysis thoughtfully to identify patterns and accelerate synthesis, while validating conclusions against reliable evidence.
* Evaluate the impact of shipped experiences on metrics such as conversion, activation, engagement, retention and customer satisfaction.
* Iterate based on evidence, identifying what to scale, what to improve and what to rethink.
* Work as a strategic partner to Product Managers and Engineering leaders, contributing to problem framing, prioritisation, scope and trade-off decisions.
* Communicate design rationale clearly and use evidence, context and sound judgment to influence stakeholders.
* Participate actively in design critiques, give constructive feedback and help raise the quality of thinking and execution across the team.
* Mentor other designers through design reviews, collaboration and sharing practical approaches to solving complex problems.
* Partner with Engineering to ensure the intent behind designs translates into high-quality shipped experiences.

* Reason for change?

* What is your notice period in days? (30)

Experience:

* Overall: 6 years (Required)
* Product Design: 6 years (Required)

**About**  
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.

Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.  
  
**Role Summary**

The Legal PMO Specialist runs the Legal PMO for Fresenius Medical Care's ("FME") Global Legal Function from the GBS India Legal Center of Excellence in Bangalore. The role holds three things together: a disciplined portfolio of legal projects, the legal technology those projects deliver, and the vendors who build, run and supply them. It combines PMO leadership with hands-on command of IT systems delivery and procurement-linked vendor governance, and also the Global Guideline Management programme.

Reporting to the Director, COE Tower Lead Legal, this role is the CoE's senior authority on how legal work gets planned, tooled, sourced and measured. It leads large, multi-region initiatives with limited oversight, sets approach and priorities for project teams, supports the Director and Global Legal Function leadership on matters of significance.

***PMO Leadership & Portfolio Governance***

* Run the Legal PMO operating model for the GBS India Legal CoE: governance cadence (steering committees, stage gates, change control), portfolio intake, prioritisation and capacity planning for Global Legal Function initiatives
* Lead large and multi-region legal projects end to end, setting project approach, milestones and priorities for project teams
* Define and enforce PMO standards, templates and methods (waterfall, agile or hybrid as the initiative demands) and train project teams to use them
* Own portfolio-level risk, dependency and issue management, escalating early to the Director and project owners

* Track project and PMO budgets and forecasts, report variances and advise the budget owner

* Support the Director on legal spend governance: invoice-to-pay alignment with Accounts Payable, accrual and spend reporting, and adherence to outside counsel billing guidelines
* Support law firm and vendor onboarding and data hygiene in legal systems (rate cards, matter and vendor records), working with Procurement, Finance/AP and the paralegal team
* Contribute to legal operations improvement - process standardisation and knowledge management in line with the CoE roadmap

* Track review-cycle adherence and guideline compliance and report both to the Director

Job Description:

**IT Operations Excellence & M&A Lead**

**Role Purpose**

Lead assigned M&A integration activities and IT Operations governance with an equal 50% allocation to each area. Plan, coordinate and govern technology integration while strengthening operational discipline, service reliability, enterprise standards and employee experience. Work across business sponsors, regional stakeholders, functional teams, acquired entities, vendors and service providers to ensure business continuity and effective transition to business-as-usual operations.

**Organization & Reporting Context**
------------------------------------

**Schneider Electric (SE)** is the global specialist in energy management, providing an integrated approach designed for the reality of the digital economy (Plant-to-Plug). The versatile product portfolio addresses all energy needs of industries as well residential. The India arm of SE started in 1995 has over 41 locations including 31 plants with over 16000 employees of which over 50% are IT users.

**About the group (SD)**: All IT needs for SE are managed by a group called Schneider Digital (SD). Spread across 235 locations in 65 countries with over 2000 staff; this group is broadly classified into four sub groups: Application Services, Technology Services, Global Delivery, Business Relationship Management (BRM). This role rolls up to the Director of Employee Experience.

**Org Structure** –Where is this position placed in the organization: The “Regions” organization is represented by global head reporting into the CIO. The global presence of “Regions” staff is divided by zones represented by zone heads and all countries are grouped under their respective zone represented by country head.

CEO->CIO> Regional CIO > Director Employee Experience> IT Lead IT Governance

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**A. M&A Activities**
---------------------

* Lead assigned post-merger technology integration activities, contributing to due diligence, Day 1 readiness, execution, stabilization and operational handover.
* Develop and maintain integration roadmaps, project plans, milestones, budgets, resource requirements and governance forums.
* Coordinate infrastructure, network, workplace technology, cloud, cybersecurity, identity, collaboration, application and data-migration workstreams with the relevant technical owners.
* Manage risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID), decision logs, critical interdependencies and executive escalations.
* Align business sponsors, acquired entities, regional teams, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement and Operations on integration priorities and delivery requirements.
* Prepare steering committee updates and executive dashboards; track delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget and enterprise standards.
* Support change communications, user readiness, adoption and hypercare; document lessons learned and complete the transition to operational ownership.

**B. IT Excellence**
--------------------

* Provide governance oversight of IT support and delivery across applications, connectivity and infrastructure, collaborating with local and global teams.
* Coordinate operational governance reviews, maintain action and deviation logs, and track remediation with accountable service and regional owners.
* Review infrastructure and network health, capacity and service trends with technical teams; govern diagnostic reviews of network problems and outages, ensuring optimization, corrective actions and follow-up remediation are documented.
* Drive consistent operational controls and documentation across daily, weekly, monthly and annual checkpoints; support audit readiness and closure of control gaps.
* Standardize business practices and IT solutions where appropriate; support infrastructure, networking, security and end-user computing enhancements and new-site readiness.
* Prepare leadership updates on operational risks, control adherence, service improvement initiatives and corrective-action progress.
* Facilitate digitization and transformation initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and employee experience.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline.

jobs.company_description:
Taylor & Francis partners with world-class authors, from leading scientists and researchers, to scholars and professionals operating at the top of their fields. Together, we publish in all areas of the Humanities, Social Sciences, Behavioural Sciences, Science, Technology and Medicine sectors. We are one of the world’s leading publishers of scholarly journals, books, eBooks, text books and reference works. 

Our network of offices has grown to include representatives in Oxford, New York, Philadelphia, Boca Raton, Boston, Melbourne, Singapore, Beijing, Tokyo, Kuala Lumpur, Stockholm, New Delhi and Johannesburg. This has enabled Taylor & Francis Group staff to provide local expertise and support to our editors, societies and authors, as well as tailored, efficient customer service to our library colleagues in institutions around the world. 

We have a passion for digital distribution (we are one of the leading publishers of online journals and eBooks) and are committed to distributing and making our journals as widely available as possible to not-for-profit institutions in developing countries. 

Making journals the home of research excellence  

Making journals the home of research excellence 

At Taylor & Francis, we are committed to publishing high quality and responsible research. Journal editors play a vital role in safeguarding the peer review process and ensuring ethical integrity. With subject expertise, they have final responsibility for the journal’s content and developing the journal to the highest standard. 

The Taylor & Francis Editor Resources website aims to provide insights and information to support the editor’s role and build connections between editors and research communities. It is our great pleasure to work with you and other editors, editorial board members, and trusted reviewers to make journals the best they can be. 

Through Editor Resources, we aim to: 

Keep you up-to-date with our latest policies and guidelines 

Help you understand your role and develop your skills in key areas of journal management 

Connect you with the editor community and share best practice with your peers 

Editor Resources consists of three main sections: 

Welcome to Taylor & Francis: a resource hub on our policies, processes and systems 

The Editor’s Role: advice from the experts on how to manage and develop journals 

Meet your Community: information on virtual and in-person events to help you network with the editor community 

Taylor & Francis is one of the world’s leading academic publishers – and one of its most enduring. 

For more than two centuries Taylor & Francis has been committed to the highest quality scholarly publishing, and this remains our goal today. Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge – something we’ve been doing since the Enlightenment. We aim to promote a positive future for everyone through our work. Our imprints include Taylor & Francis, Routledge, CRC Press, F1000 Research and Dovepress. We’ve published over 145,000 book titles, and we publish over 2,700 journals.  

Taylor & Francis partners with researchers, scholarly societies, universities and libraries worldwide to bring knowledge to life. As one of the world’s leading publishers of scholarly journals, books, eBooks and reference works, our content spans all areas of Humanities, Social Sciences, Behavioural Sciences, Medicine, Pharma, Science, Technology, and more! 

We’ve been advancing research and enriching lives since the 18th Century. Taylor & Francis was founded in London in 1852, but our roots go back to 1798 when Richard Taylor launched the Philosophical Magazine, one of the first scientific journals. Routledge, which Taylor & Francis acquired in 1998, was also founded in 1852 and is now considered to be the leading English-language publisher of humanities and social sciences. The merged company has become one of the top five research publishers globally.  

In 2003 we acquired CRC Press, best known for titles in engineering, materials science, and mathematics. In 2004 Taylor & Francis merged with Informa and has been its academic publishing division since then. More recent acquisitions include Dove Medical Press in 2017, which specializes in medical journals; and, in 2020, F1000. F1000 provides open research publishing venues that support data deposition and sharing to research funders and institutions. These include the European Commission, Wellcome and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.  

Today our brands advance knowledge across humanities and social sciences, science and technology, engineering, medicine and healthcare. 

About Taylor & Francis - Taylor & Francis (taylorandfrancis.com) - website link.

Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Anthropic, Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

**ROLE PURPOSE**

This role bridges Finance and technology, taking hands-on ownership of the design, build, implementation and continuous improvement of Workday Adaptive Planning solutions. It translates FP&A requirements into scalable models, integrations, workflows, reports and controls, while ensuring solutions are tested, documented, supportable and adopted by users.

**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE**

Success will be measured through stable and scalable models, reliable integrations, accurate data, controlled releases, faster planning cycles, improved user adoption, reduced manual work and delivery of enhancements that generate measurable business value.

**Solution Design and Implementation**

* Lead or support the full delivery lifecycle for Adaptive Planning solutions, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare and handover.
* Translate business requirements into documented functional and technical specifications, solution options, acceptance criteria and implementation plans.
* Design and build scalable, driver-based models for revenue, workforce, operating expenditure, capital expenditure, balance sheet, cash flow and other planning requirements.
* Configure and maintain levels, dimensions, attributes, accounts, versions, assumptions, modelled sheets, cube sheets, standard sheets, formulas, allocations and workflow.
* Design solutions for multi-entity, multi-currency and scenario-planning requirements, balancing usability, performance, control and maintainability.
* Assess existing models for complexity, performance bottlenecks and technical debt, then implement controlled remediation.

**Integration, Data and Security**

* Design, build, schedule, monitor and troubleshoot data integrations and loads between Adaptive Planning and ERP, PSA, HR, CRM, data-platform and reporting systems.
* Develop mapping, transformation, validation and reconciliation routines to maintain complete, accurate and traceable data flows.
* Configure role-based access, permissions, process controls and workflow to support appropriate segregation of duties and secure user access.
* Maintain hierarchies, metadata and master data in coordination with system owners and data-governance stakeholders.
* Investigate production incidents, perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes with appropriate audit evidence.

**Reporting and User Experience**

* Build and maintain Adaptive web reports, dashboards, hubs and OfficeConnect reporting packs for management and operational users.
* Create intuitive planning templates and user journeys that support efficient submissions, reviews, approvals and self-service analysis.
* Partner with Power BI and data teams to align metric definitions, hierarchies and outputs across planning and reporting solutions.
* Gather user feedback and usage information to prioritise enhancements and improve adoption.

**Testing, Release and Support**

* Prepare unit, system, integration, regression and user-acceptance test plans; manage defects and evidence results before release.
* Maintain backlog items, estimates, dependencies and release documentation within the agreed Agile delivery process.
* Apply structured change control, version management and deployment practices across development and production environments.
* Create and maintain architecture diagrams, configuration records, data dictionaries, interface specifications, runbooks, process guides, user guides and change logs.
* Deliver training, demonstrations, knowledge-transfer sessions, office hours and tiered support for administrators, super-users and end users.
* Monitor Workday product releases and evaluate relevant features, risks and opportunities for the planning environment.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activity, strengthen controls, simplify models and improve calculation or load performance.
* Recommend and prototype responsible AI-enabled improvements where they provide clear value and can be governed appropriately.
* Contribute to connected planning across Finance, Delivery, Workforce, Sales and Operations by aligning drivers, assumptions and outputs.
* Provide technical estimates, delivery updates, risk assessments and solution recommendations to FP&A and technology stakeholders.

  
**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Typically 6+ years’ hands-on experience configuring, developing, implementing or materially enhancing Workday Adaptive Planning solutions.
* Demonstrable experience building Adaptive models, sheets, dimensions, versions, assumptions, formulas, allocations, reports, dashboards, security and workflow.

This team oversees the end-to-end supply network — from product, portfolio and network strategy through to operational delivery and distribution — ensuring that we meet patient needs efficiently, safely and sustainably across all our markets.
  
  
Supply Chain and Strategy within Global Supply Chain brings together planning, customer supply chain, external manufacturing, classic and established products, and other specialist teams into one connected organisation with full visibility across the supply chain. By joining this team, you’ll help build a world-class, data-driven and resilient supply chain ready for the future, combining science, technology and talent to make sure GSK’s products reach the people who need them, wherever they are.

Equity Index Data Management (EIDM) is part of the Benchmarks & Indices Operations. We are a client-focused, technology-enabled team producing high-value index data for internal and external clients. EIDM owns the underlying reference data used in the calculation of equity index products globally. **Job Title: Cyber Shared Services Senior Analyst**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

**About the role**

The Cyber Shared Services Senior Analyst turns the work, spend and performance of Solventum's Cybersecurity organization into clear, reliable information for leadership. This person builds the reports and scorecards, tracks the budget and vendor spend, and makes sure actions and escalations are followed through to closure.The role is built around metrics and AI. The Senior Analyst owns the data behind Cyber's KPIs, key risk indicators and service levels, works closely with the Shared Services Manager and with Jeff Szabo's catalog, finance and metrics backbone, and uses AI tools to automate how that data is gathered, analyzed and reported across all of Cyber.

**What you will do**

* Build and maintain the monthly and quarterly Cyber reports, dashboards and scorecards for the Director and CISO.
* Collect status, metrics and risk information from every Cyber pillar and check it for accuracy.
* Track the Cyber budget, forecasts, purchase orders and vendor spend, and reconcile them with Finance.
* Highlight trends, variances and issues, and prepare the facts the Manager needs to escalate.
* Follow up on action items and escalations from leadership meetings until they are closed.
* Keep the Cyber service catalog, request intake and supporting records accurate and current.
* Prepare leadership presentations and briefing material that are concise and easy to act on.
* Use AI tools to automate data gathering, draft summaries and cut the time spent on manual reporting.
* Guide and review the work of the Cyber Shared Services Analyst.

**AI focus**

The Senior Analyst is the team's hands-on AI practitioner. This person builds and refines AI-assisted reporting, such as Copilot prompts and templates that summarize status across pillars, draft leadership updates and pull together meeting notes and actions. The aim is accurate information delivered faster, with less manual effort for everyone in Cyber. All AI use follows Solventum policy on data handling and responsible use.

Required

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, commerce, information systems or a related field.
* 6 or more years in business analysis, reporting, financial tracking or operations support.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Comfort with budgets, forecasts and spend reconciliation.
* Clear, well-organized written and spoken English, suited to senior audiences.
* Attention to detail and a habit of following through until work is closed.
* Regular use of AI and productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Preferred

* Experience supporting an IT, technology or security organization.
* Experience working with US-based teams across time zones.
* Experience building automated reports or dashboards.

Success in the first year

* Leadership reports and scorecards are delivered on time, every cycle, with accurate data.
* Budget and vendor spend reconcile cleanly with Finance each month.
* Open actions and escalations are tracked to closure with clear owners and dates.
* At least two recurring reports are produced largely through AI-assisted automation.

jobs.description:
About the Role  
  
Join the **Data Analytics (DA)** team at **TII** across domains such as **Marketing and Digital, Merchandising, Supply Chain and Logistics, Store Operations, Finance** and more**.** Here you'll collaborate with business leaders to turn data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You’ll be part of a fast-moving, high-impact environment focused on leveraging business intelligence and advanced analytics to solve real-world problems.  
This role combines technical expertise with business understanding to uncover and communicate actionable insights using cutting-edge statistical and analytical techniques.  
  
Behind one of the world’s best loved brands is a uniquely capable and brilliant team of data scientists, engineers and analysts. The Target Data & Analytics team creates the tools and data products to sustainably educate and enable our business partners to make great data-based decisions at Target. We help develop the technology that personalizes the guest experience, from product recommendations to relevant ad content. We’re also the source of the data and analytics behind Target’s Internet of Things (iOT) applications, fraud detection, Supply Chain optimization and demand forecasting. We play a key role in identifying the test-and-measure or A/B test opportunities that continuously help Target improve the guest experience, whether they love to shop in stores or at Target.com.

Key Responsibilities:  
 Translate business problems into well-defined analytical questions and structured  
approaches  
 Support scenario, decision, and action modelling to evaluate business trade-offs and  
inform recommended actions  
 Partner with Target business stakeholders to understand priorities and roadmaps,  
validate analytical requirements, and present insights and recommendations with clarity  
and impact  
 Develop and deliver analytical and AI-driven solutions (including GenAI, Agent, and  
Agentic approaches) that enable decision support, forecasting, optimization, and  
automation  
 Apply advanced analytics techniques, including causal, predictive, and prescriptive  
analytics, to drive deeper understanding of business levers and inform optimal actions  
 Work with large-scale datasets using platforms such as GCP BigQuery, Spark, and SQL-  
based data warehouses; build and maintain reliable data pipelines using Airflow or  
similar orchestration tools  
 Contribute to AI-driven analytical workflows, defining quality metrics (e.g., accuracy,  
relevance), assessing reliability, and measuring tangible business impact  
 Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, scalable, and aligned with business context  
 Develop strong data storytelling skills to communicate insights and recommendations to  
non-technical audiences  
 Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, and outputs to support reuse and  
knowledge sharing  
 Adhere to corporate data protection standards and responsible AI practices  
Requirements / About You:  
Experience: Overall 5-8 years exp and relevant 3-5 years exp  
Qualification:  
TI : B.Tech / B.E. or Masters in Statistics /Econometrics/Mathematics equivalent  
US : BA/BS in a quantitative degree – Math, Statistics, Econometrics, Data  
Sciences, Computer Science or equivalent work experience  
Skills required:  
1. Extensive exposure to Structured Query Language (SQL), SQL Optimization and  
DW/BI concepts.  
2. Proven hands-on experience in BI Visualization tool (i.e. PBI, Looker, Tableau) with  
ability to learn additional vendor and proprietary visualizations tools.  
3. Strong knowledge of structured (i.e. Teradata, Oracle, Hive) and unstructured  
databases including Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS). Exposure and extensive  
hands-on work with large data sets.  
4. Hands on experience in R, Python, Hive or other open-source languages/database  
5. Hands on experience in any advanced analytical techniques like Regression, Time-  
series models, Classification Techniques, etc. and conceptual understanding of all  
the techniques mentioned above  
6. Git source code management & experience working in an agile environment.  
7. Strong attention to detail, excellent diagnostic, and problem-solving skills  
8. Highly self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency to be able to work both  
independently and in team settings in a fast-paced environment; capability to  
manage urgency timelines  
9. Competent and curious to ask questions and learn to fill gaps, desire to teach and  
learn.  
10. Excellent communication, service orientation and strong relationship building skills  
11. Experience with Retail, Merchandising, Marketing will be strong addons  
12. Hands-on experience leveraging Generative AI (GenAI) and LLM-based solutions  
(e.g., prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation – RAG) to enhance data  
analysis, automate insight generation, and support business decision-making  
13. Ability to integrate AI-driven tools and AI-agent workflows into end-to-end analytical  
processes, enabling automation, improving productivity, and scaling analytics use  
cases.

* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

-------------------

jobs.description:
**Equity Index Data Analyst — Job Description**

  

**Team Overview — Benchmarks & Indices Operations**
===================================================

Equity Index Data Management (EIDM) is part of the Benchmarks & Indices Operations. We are a client-focused, technology-enabled team producing high-value index data for internal and external clients. EIDM owns the underlying reference data used in the calculation of equity index products globally. We maintain LSEG intellectual property by generating and maintaining: ICB Classifications, Free Float, Voting Rights, Nationality, Universe preparation, Liquidity, and similar data points for Index Review, Rebalance, and Reconstitution cycles.

**Role Purpose**
================

We are recruiting an Equity Index Data Analyst for our EIDM team in Bengaluru. You will manage a broad set of quantitative and qualitative equity data across a global universe of companies, ensuring best-in-class quality and accuracy across all EIDM products. Equities Index Data plays a pivotal role in supporting global index data operations across multiple asset classes (predominantly Equity), ensuring operational continuity, data integrity, and strategic alignment across global teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Analyse, extract, standardize, and maintain quantitative and qualitative equity data from multiple information sources—including annual reports, company websites, and regulatory filings of public companies. Apply and uphold defined Index policies and ground rules to ensure a high degree of data quality and policy compliance.

* Perform primary research and calculations for: free float, voting rights, shares in issue (total shares outstanding), nationality, industry classification (ICB), country assignment, universe collation, liquidity testing, and IPO set ups.

* Conduct primary research during index review periods and draft first responses for client queries, consistent with policy and internal guidance

* Perform Quality Control (QC) on peer outputs and provide constructive feedback to improve overall quality. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on data issues and drive action plans that prevent recurrence.

* Identify and recommend automation or process optimization opportunities that reduce effort and risk in data management and analysis. Collaborate with senior team members to implement, test, and document improvements.

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs for all relevant workflows, aligned with risk and governance guidelines.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent (MBA, CFA, CA preferred)

* 1+ years of experience in capital/financial markets, preferably financial research or index operations

* Hands-on experience with key financial and referential equity datasets—notably entity masters, pricing, and classifications

* Strong technology literacy:

* Intermediate MS Office (especially Excel); experience with Power Apps, Power Automate (or similar)

* Beginner-level SQL

* Beginner-level familiarity with AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini

**Core Skills**
---------------

* Meticulous attention to detail; strong analytical and problem solving skills

* Ability to interpret and apply Index policies and ground rules consistently

* Clear written communication (especially for client query drafting)

* Time management under strict deadlines and cyclical workloads

* Documentation discipline (SOPs, RCAs, QC feedback) and collaborative mindset

**Career Stage:**

Associate

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

**About the role:**

Latinum is looking for an experienced Business Data Analyst for a client to drive end-to-end delivery of enterprise data, analytics, and reporting initiatives.

The role involves partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyse business processes and datasets, assess solution feasibility, and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications. * Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, process flows, business rules, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and project documentation.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering and BI teams.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers throughout the SDLC to clarify requirements, track implementation, resolve functional issues, and ensure successful delivery.
* Write and optimise SQL queries on Azure Synapse and Salesforce staging data for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
* Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards, reports, and DAX measures for enterprise reporting and KPI tracking.
* Define and validate requirements for data integrations, reporting, automation, and data quality improvements.
* Coordinate SIT and UAT, manage defects, validate acceptance criteria, and obtain stakeholder sign-off.
* Support production deployments and post-production hypercare, coordinating issue resolution between business and technical teams.
* Maintain KPI definitions, data dictionaries, governance artefacts, and reporting standards while managing multiple initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Enterprise Reporting within large or complex organisations.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end requirements and delivery across discovery, analysis, documentation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong expertise in business process analysis, EDA, gap analysis, and technical feasibility assessments.
* Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in Azure Synapse Analytics or equivalent MPP/cloud data warehouse platforms.

* Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with Data Engineering teams.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
* Strong documentation skills, including BRDs, FRDs, process flows, and testing artefacts.
* Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Real Estate industry experience is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ideal Candidate: A strong Business Data Analyst who combines business requirements ownership, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, Azure data platform exposure, and end-to-end SDLC delivery experience.

A Data Analyst is a professional who is responsible for collecting, processing, analyzing, and interpreting complex data sets to provide actionable insights that drive business decisions.This role typically requires a combination of technical skills, domain knowledge, and strong communication abilities. Candidate is required to work on the following activities:

1. Conduct a comprehensive analysis of the responses received from providers, examining each question, and proposing any necessary question deletions. (no. of questions attempted by the service providers, most answered/unanswered questions)
2. Identify any notable insights or trends discovered during the analysis and communicate them to the Lead Analyst.
3. Track the survey daily and provide updates to the project team.
4. Analyze the data and generate all possible insights from complex datasets.
5. Conduct a Quantitative data analysis and build a Dashboard either Power BI or Excel.

Here are the common requirements for a Data Analyst role, including a focus on databases: **Educational Background:**

* A bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. Master's degree or higher is preferred.

**Technical Skills:**

* Data Analysis with Python: Proficiency in using Python for data manipulation, cleaning, and analysis. Familiarity with libraries like pandas, numpy, and scipy for data handling.
* Excel Proficiency: Strong skills in Excel, including functions, formulas, pivot tables, data visualization, and basic macros.
* Data Visualization: Ability to create clear and informative visualizations using Python libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn for enhanced data communication.
* SQL: Basic knowledge of SQL for querying databases and extracting relevant data.

**Data Handling:**

* Data Cleaning and Transformation: Ability to clean and preprocess raw data, handle missing values, and transform data into a usable format.
* Data Extraction: Proficiency in extracting data from various sources, including databases, APIs, CSV files, and Excel spreadsheets.

**Problem-Solving Skills:**

* Analytical Thinking: Capacity to analyze complex data sets, identify patterns, and draw meaningful insights to address business questions.
* Critical Thinking: Ability to approach problems logically, formulate hypotheses, and develop data-driven solutions.

**Communication Skills:**

* Data Reporting: Ability to present findings effectively through reports and visualizations that convey insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Data Storytelling: Skill in translating data findings into compelling narratives that drive decision-making.

**Collaboration:**

* Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.

**Tools and Technologies:**

* Proficiency in using Python for data analysis (pandas, numpy), data visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn), and potentially Jupyter notebooks.
* Strong Excel skills, including functions, formulas, pivot tables, charts, and data manipulation.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools, especially Generative AI (e.g., GPT-5, Copilot, ChatGPT).
* Ability to leverage GPT for tasks such as automating data documentation and reporting, generating code snippets or SQL queries, enhancing data quality checks and anomaly detection, and summarizing large datasets or reports.

**Additional Skills (depending on the role and industry):**

* Familiarity with statistical concepts and techniques for data analysis.
* Basic knowledge of database querying languages (SQL).
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts.

**Experience:**

* 2-3 years of relevant experience in data analysis or related roles, showcasing your ability to work with real-world data and generate insights.

jobs.title: E-commerce Merchandiser
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a result-oriented E-commerce Merchandiser who can identify new product opportunities, conduct market research, analyze business performance, and develop strategies to increase product sales. The candidate will be responsible for understanding market demand, researching competitors, identifying potential products, and planning strategies to grow the company's online business.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* New Product Research: Identify new and trending products based on market demand, customer needs, and business opportunities.
* Market Research: Research market trends, customer preferences, competitor products, pricing, and product demand.
* Business Analysis: Analyze sales data, product performance, market opportunities, and profitability to support business decisions.
* Product Growth Strategy: Develop strategies to increase product visibility, demand, and sales across online platforms.
* Competitor Analysis: Monitor competitor pricing, product ranges, marketing strategies, and market positioning.
* Product Selection: Evaluate potential new products based on demand, competition, pricing, profit margins, and growth opportunities.
* Sales Performance Monitoring: Track product-wise sales and identify best-selling and underperforming products.
* Online Marketplace Research: Research opportunities on Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.
* Product Listing Improvement: Suggest improvements in product titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and pricing to improve visibility and sales.
* Business Opportunity Identification: Recommend new product categories and expansion opportunities to support company growth.
* Reporting: Prepare regular reports on market research, competitor analysis, product performance, and new product opportunities.
* Team Coordination: Coordinate with sales, marketing, purchasing, and other relevant teams to implement product growth strategies.

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* Graduate in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a relevant field.
* 34 years of experience in e-commerce, product research, merchandising, or market analysis.
* Practical knowledge of Amazon, Flipkart, or other online marketplaces.
* Strong market research and analytical skills.
* Good understanding of product pricing, competition, customer demand, and sales growth strategies.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and sales reporting.
* Ability to identify profitable product opportunities and support business growth.
* Good communication, planning, and problem-solving skills.
